$comment: Twelve real screenshots from the Historical Bingo 'Who's That Pokémon!?' (slug whos-that-pokemon), picked for a spread of Teams, items and formats: ten approved drops and two approved Proof screenshots. `codeword` is the word the Team showed on screen at the time (the old site's Codeword, next to the date stamp or typed in chat; the import gave the Teams new ones, so it isn't in the database); `terms` is what the matcher must find (the approved Claim's item name for a drop). The files live in the site's uploads directory under `file` and need a logged-in clan member to download (see ocr-compare.ts --fetch-from).

images.note: Blood Shards tile: collection log showing the current shard count
